review: Successful native capture: fixed-coordinate absolute bind and correction-enabled animation orientation review

fixedConversion.notation: Column vectors; 4x4 row-major JSON; no best-fit, common-root normalization, inverse-current-root alignment, or optional yaw correction.
fixedConversion.expectedUnityBoneWorldFormula: R * C * T(-exportOrigin) * authorRigWorld * authorBoneRestLocal * R
fixedConversion.rightReflectionReason: Convert local basis handedness too; left-only reflection would have negative determinant and would not describe a Unity Transform.
fixedConversion.rigForwardInterpretation: CoshaRig local +Z maps to world +Y. It is not character anatomical front; top root +Z is checked absolutely.

sameFramePlayerSourceComparisons.comparison: Unaligned absolute Player versus Source world matrices at the same actual Animator frame. Animated matrices are not tested against Rest.
Unaligned absolute Player versus Source world matrices at the same actual Animator frame. Animated matrices are not tested against Rest.

summary.nativeSuccessfulScope: Captured FBX/Source/Player disabled bind plus two disposable owned previews with actual Animator Idle/Walk samples at normalized time 0.35, correction enabled.

limits: No live Adventure actor existed during acquisition; all animated evidence is from explicitly owned disposable previews.
Animated bone matrices are compared only between Player and Source at the same actual Animator frame, never to author Rest.
Avatar reference T-pose is not used as a mesh bind oracle.
No root inverse alignment, common yaw fitting, arbitrary rotation, Unity/Blender invocation, compile, or Assets write was performed by this audit.

absoluteAnimatedFrontDirections.method: Author front Blender -Y converts to absolute Unity +Z. Bind that world direction into the fixed author Hips Rest local frame, then transform the same direction through each sampled Hips matrix. No fitted rotation, no inverse current-root alignment, and no assertion that animated Hips equals Rest.

authorFrontAnatomicalCorroboration.method: Convert source Rest foot/toe head-to-tail vectors with the same fixed R*C*authorRigWorld linear part. The vectors corroborate +Z front without changing the chosen absolute basis or fitting a common yaw.
